title: Yellow Creamy Middle Eastern Tomato Bowl
description: A tangy and creamy Middle Eastern dish featuring chopped tomatoes, served in a dolsot stone bowl, perfect for meal prep. This recipe is low-fat-friendly and can be prepared in under 30 minutes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, sumac, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped tomatoes to the bowl and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a dolsot stone bowl.
Bake the mixture in the preheated oven for 15 minutes.
Remove the bowl from the oven and garnish with chopped parsley.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Serve the Yellow Creamy Middle Eastern Tomato Bowl chilled.
